review_sphinx_conf: review the Sphinx conf.py configuration file for extensions, theme, and project metadata settings
summarize_sphinx_conf: summarize the Sphinx documentation build configuration including extensions and theme options
review_patched_make_field: review the patched_make_field function that prevents Sphinx from cross-referencing ivar tags in docfields
review_setup_app: review the setup function that configures recommonmark and adds the AutoStructify transform to the Sphinx app
refactor_sphinx_conf: refactor the Sphinx conf.py to update extensions, theme options, or autodoc mock imports
